normative_semantics: EXACTLY-ONE-TERMINAL: enforced by storage CAS + uniqueness constraints, never by a watchdog (watchdog is evidence collection only)
PROJECTION-RECONSTRUCTION: projections are rebuilt from the authoritative store (journal/event chain), never from volatile memory, across writer restart and recovery
FIRST-FAILURE-RETENTION: the first terminal outcome is retained; later conflicting terminal attempts are rejected and never overwrite it
UNKNOWN and BLOCKED are never reportable as PASS

typed_outcome_vocabulary.CRASH:CrashError: residual.dsm.store.CrashError at the injected crash point (simulated process death; caller never sees an ack)
typed_outcome_vocabulary.DISPOSITION:duplicate: submit()/deliver() returns duplicate; no new journal record
typed_outcome_vocabulary.LEASE:revoked: LeaseRead.state == 'revoked' (missing/terminal/mismatched row is revoked, never unknown)
typed_outcome_vocabulary.LEASE:unknown: LeaseRead.state == 'unknown' with bounded diag (exc_type, sqlite_errorcode) only; MUST NOT be retyped as revoked or pass
typed_outcome_vocabulary.BLOCKED: operation does not commit; caller retries; no acknowledgement issued
typed_outcome_vocabulary.KILL:process: child process terminated at the injected fault point (simulated SIGKILL window)

vectors.title: Commit-before-ack crash: SQLite FULL-sync COMMIT window (subprocess kill)

vectors.title: Concurrent terminal attempts: double-finish race
vectors.normative_reference: EXACTLY-ONE-TERMINAL under concurrency: _lock serialization + state-row CAS; exactly one winner; watchdog not involved

vectors.stimulus: thread1 finish(FAILED) vs thread2 finish(VIOLATED), repeated over 20 fresh-journal interleavings

vectors.title: Scheduler unavailable during recovery: degrade to re-triage, never to pass
vectors.normative_reference: no terminal success may be recorded for an attempt whose scheduler context was lost; recovery force-blocks in-flight local work and retains evidence

vectors.title: Lease-read tri-state integrity under corruption pressure
vectors.normative_reference: 'unknown' is returned ONLY when the durable store cannot be read or the caller budget is exhausted; a missing/terminal/mismatched row is 'revoked', never 'unknown'; callers must never retype 'unknown' as revocation or pass
vectors.fault_injection: four modes: row deleted out-of-band; revoked flag flipped out-of-band; caller deadline already exhausted; DB file corrupted (garbage bytes)
vectors.evidence_destination: runner report: captured LeaseRead tuples per mode
